mapper.select: SELECT user_no AS userNo, user_id AS userId, password, name, email, phone, role, join_date AS joinDate, driver_license AS driverLicense, point FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_no, password, name, email, phone, role, join_date, driver_license, point, user_id ) VALUES ( user_seq.NEXTVAL, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, '1234567890', 'USER', SYSDATE, null, 0, #{userId} )
